announcements.text: sqlite3 3.45.1 is installed on the HOST at /usr/bin/sqlite3 — read a host DB in place with the mode=ro URI, and never copy one to inspect it. A container read path is a different filesystem: Alpine images ship no CLI, so an exec'd python3-module read stays as it is.
announcements.evidence: owner order 2026-09-19 10:52Z -> apt-get install -y sqlite3 -> 3.45.1 at /usr/bin/sqlite3; sqlite3 --version rc=0
